# Catalogue run status (generated by `tq r2run catalogue --write`)

Whether this engine (long-only, one account, one calendar, daily bars) can run each family of the frozen catalogue. A NOT-RUN family is not a failure: it is not KILL, not INCONCLUSIVE-SAMPLE, not DEV-GO; it opens no sweep and consumes no trial cell (it stays in the frozen catalogue, uncounted, as addendum 1 section 6 says for intraday-nse and pairs-cr). `tq r2run plan` and `run-sweep` refuse it with this message.
